entry.title: [UPDATED] PYSEC-2026-4319: A security flaw has been discovered in vllm-project vLLM up to 0.31.0. This impacts the function get_token_bin_counts_an
entry.content:
Aliases: CVE-2026-105922

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:L/UI:N/VC:N/VI:N/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N/E:P/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X

Affected:

  • vllm — fixed in 0.32.0

A security flaw has been discovered in vllm-project vLLM up to 0.31.0. This impacts the function get_token_bin_counts_and_mask of the file vllm/model_executor/layers/utils.py of the component Penalty Handler. Performing a manipulation results in denial of service. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-w5f2-9q9c-ff4h: LMCache: Remote code execution via unsafe deserialization in multiprocess mode transport
entry.content:
LMCache: Remote code execution via unsafe deserialization in multiprocess mode transport

Aliases: CVE-2026-105192

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

Affected:

  • lmcache — fixed in 0.5.6

### Summary LMCache is vulnerable to Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Pickle Deserialization on the Multiprocess ZMQ Transport ### Details LMCache multiprocess mode, also called distributed mode, opens an unauthenticated ZeroMQ ROUTER so worker processes can register and share KV cache blocks. The intended clients are sibling LMCache processes. There is no CURVE, ZAP, password, or message authentication on that socket. LMCache used only inside a vLLM process does not open this port. The transport binds to localhost unless the operator sets a routable address with --host, which is how multi-node deployments let peers connect. The 9.8 score is for that routable configuration. A stock single-host install that leaves the default bind is not reachable from other machines. Message…

entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-h4mw-j7qp-8mwm: Claude Agent SDK: Argument Injection via resume Option Allows Arbitrary Command Execution
entry.content:
Claude Agent SDK: Argument Injection via resume Option Allows Arbitrary Command Execution

Aliases: CVE-2026-96620

Severity: CVSS_V4: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:P/PR:N/UI:N/VC:H/VI:H/VA:H/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N

Affected:

  • claude-agent-sdk — fixed in 0.2.121

The Claude Agent SDK for Python passed the `resume` option to the Claude CLI without validation, allowing a value beginning with `-` to be interpreted as a separate CLI flag. An attacker who controlled the `resume` value could inject an `--mcp-config` flag defining a stdio MCP server, resulting in arbitrary command execution at CLI startup that bypassed the SDK's permission controls. Exploitation required an application to pass untrusted input as the session ID to resume. Users are advised to update to the latest version of the claude-agent-sdk package. Thank you to hackerone.com/moamenmahmood for reporting this issue.

  • https://github.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python/security/advisories/GHSA-h4mw-j7qp-8mwm

entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-vgf9-9mxx-hq54: ClickMigrate has Path Traversal in "revision -m" argument
entry.content:
ClickMigrate has Path Traversal in "revision -m" argument

Aliases: CVE-2026-68549

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N

Affected:

  • clickmigrate — fixed in 1.0.3

### Impact A path traversal vulnerability in the `revision` command allowed a crafted migration name supplied via the `-m` argument to escape the intended migrations directory. Under specific conditions, an attacker could cause the tool to create a `.sql` file in an arbitrary location writable by the user executing the command. This issue is only exploitable if an attacker can influence the migration name passed to the `revision` command, such as through an insecure automation or CI/CD pipeline that forwards untrusted input. ### Patches The vulnerability has been fixed in version 1.0.3 by validating and sanitizing the migration name to prevent directory traversal. Users should upgrade to version 1.0.3 or later. ### Workarounds Do not pass untrusted input to the `revision -m` argument.…

entry.title: [NEW] MAL-2026-17866: Malicious code in pyyi (PyPI)
entry.content:
Malicious code in pyyi (PyPI)

Affected:

  • pyyi

The verified PyPI wheel declares a console command named python2 (pyyi.cli:main). For commands other than the local REPL, help, version, unlock, or uninstall paths, it obtains configuration and calls run_payload(). Registration sends the hostname and OS to a configured space-z.ai server and stores the returned apiKey in ~/.python2/config.json. The REPL presents a normal Python banner but silently sends eligible single-token inputs to /api/cli/unlock as the password field, subject to filtering and attempt limits. run_payload() fetches code from /api/cli/payload, base64-decodes and gzip-decompresses it, then executes it in memory using exec(compile(src, '<adv>', 'exec'), g) at pyyi/cli.py:640 and calls its main function. Loader failures are disguised as Python's can't open file error. The ma…
